query:
SELECT fp.id, fp.targetUserId, fp.predictorTwinId, fp.scenarioId, fp.predictedVerdict, fp.comparedAt,
       dt.name as predictorName
FROM friend_predictions fp
LEFT JOIN digital_twins dt ON fp.predictorTwinId = dt.id
ORDER BY fp.id DESC
LIMIT 10
